interface.defaultPrompt: Find the original source of an earlier technical decision in my configured MemPalace.
interface.longDescription: Connect MemPalace to OpenAI workflows. Retrieve source-grounded memories with read-only access and traceable references. This independent community connector supports locally configured sqlite_exact/rust_exact and Chroma SQLite FTS5 indices, bounded excerpts and explicit wing allowlists. It does not modify source data. ChatGPT host compatibility depends on available local MCP execution; ordinary chats remain unverified. Not affiliated with OpenAI or MemPalace maintainers.
interface.shortDescription: Read-only MemPalace search with source references
